model_policy.format: query paired with title newline and a complete sliding body window; title repeated for every window
model_policy.query_title: prefix truncate only, count dropped tokens
model_policy.body: all tokens covered, overlap128, no cap on number of windows
model_policy.aggregation: maximum raw single relevance logit over all windows; no sigmoid or handcrafted score mixture
model_policy.inference: eval/inference_mode, float32 eager attention, torch_seed0, cpu_threads4, MPS when available, else CPU; local-only safetensors and no remote code
model_policy.failure: stop model run, preserve complete checkpoint prefix; never substitute rule scores as model output
model_policy.cache: deduplicate exact query/title/content within a pinned model and protocol; preserve full pool candidate identities; record new/cached pair counts; no cross-model reuse

selection.regression_gates: No new evidence losses and no aggregate source completeness regression on every source/split, including development. Failure stops this candidate; do not select another using regression scores.

measurement.unit: 384 source-query pools x5 strategies; 304 unique question IDs; 2 dedicated cross-encoders, 1 RRF cap diagnostic
measurement.primary: unchanged literal annotated evidence; frozen v1 gates including no new literal evidence loss; choose only development, no alternate candidate after regression failure
measurement.semantic: report prior ten-loss facts separately with unchanged original labels; no new global semantic score or Precision
measurement.timing: model load and synthetic warmup excluded; per-query tokenization+transfer+inference+window aggregation timed and synchronized; exact pair cache hits separately recorded, never presented as full uncached latency; no API concurrency/production performance claim

boundaries: No retrieval, answer generation, publication/ACL runtime retest or production configuration changes
RRF cap5 is diagnostic only: same Top5/6000 but changed document distribution; cannot pass adoption gate
No parameter sweeps, model substitution by observed scores, question-specific business keyword rules, label edits or silent fallback
All corpora exposed and assistant-authored; best observed candidate is not independent production acceptance
New model weights fetched from ModelScope mirror with pinned mirror commit and individual SHA256, not claimed byte-equivalent to unavailable Hugging Face revision
